The rear passenger quarter panel and rear door on the driver's side show scraping, a crease along the lower edge,
and a cracked taillight lens, all consistent with a sideways contact at low speed while the other vehicle moved into the

the taillight assembly, straightening and refinishing the rear door, and blending the quarter panel into the adjacent
paint. The labor hours requested fit the work described. Parts and paint charges on the invoices appear once each,
with no duplicated line items. Nothing in the vehicle's history or the shop's records suggests earlier damage to these
areas.
